categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Has the Mempool label and optimizes CTxMemPool::GetSortedScoreWithTopology() and TxGraph traversal.
categories.rationale: Substantially improves CPU performance and reduces critical mempool lock contention by replacing an O(N log N) sort with an O(N) chunk traversal. Benchmarks cited in the description show getrawmempool execution dropping from 99 ms to 24 ms on 60k transactions and RpcMempoolTxids falling from 5.10 ms to 1.07 ms, reducing mempool lock holding time for callers like indexers.
